attributes.action: Social Media should be Restricted instead of Banning it for Under 16s
attributes.background: We are campaigning for a safer internet without removing young people's voices. Instead of a total social media ban, we want harmful features restricted. Let's protect teen wellbeing while preserving our vital space for self-expression, news, and connection.

rejection.details:
We are not sure exactly what changes you would like the Government to introduce. You may wish to sign these petitions which call for similar actions: 

Review and strengthen protections for children online
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/763698

Require curfews and scrolling breaks on social media for under 16s, don't ban it
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/761589

Ban engagement-driven algorithms that push provocative content on social media
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/760642
